summary: Website includes an owner-only enquiries viewing page protected by Internet Identity; user wants to add an additional admin with access.
architectural_notes: Owner-only enquiries page is protected via Internet Identity (no manual passkey/password).

existing_features.title: Add a frontend admin management section on the Enquiries dashboard that allows an authorized admin to add and remove authorized admin emails.

Update the frontend authorization/diagnostic logic so it does not rely on a hardcoded admin email list; it should instead use the backend-managed email list for any “Email Authorized” diagnostics shown in the Access Denied view.

Add clear user-facing guidance on the Enquiries login/access screen describing what is required for a new admin to gain access: the new admin must log in with Internet Identity and set their profile email to the authorized email that the owner/admin has added.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add support for an additional admin account to access the owner-only enquiries page (Internet Identity-based access control).

Add backend support to manage multiple enquiry admins by storing an editable, persistent list of authorized admin emails (instead of a hardcoded constant list) and using it for enquiry authorization checks.
Expose backend admin-management APIs for enquiries access: list authorized admin emails, add an authorized admin email, and remove an authorized admin email.
